verdict.rationale: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a hardware processor/SoC with an AI development SDK for building and running models; it is not a product with a built-in end-user AI assistant to delegate tasks to. This axis applies to consumer assistant products/agents, not to a CPU/NPU platform whose evidence only covers developer tooling like ONNX Runtime, Quark quantization, and Lemonade SDK.
